QuestInfo.name: [Sengoku Warriors] Touch of Chaos
QuestInfo.0: Athena Pierce mentions that she noticed someone suspicious. Talk to Athena Pierce.
QuestInfo.1: Athena Pierce tells you that she noticed someone making contact with the Black Wings. Find out what's going on from the Black Wings' hideout.
QuestInfo.2: Thanks to Athena Pierce's tip-off, you found out about a meeting between Akechi Mitsuhide and the Black Wings.
